## NEXUS: one side, full bed access, zero prop rods


Every truck owner knows the routine. Open the cover, prop it with a rod, walk around to the other side, do it again. **NEXUS** removes that routine. It is the first Worksport hard tonneau cover with an **Auto Flip-Up** design. Flip it up from one side and it automatically locks upright. You get full bed access from that side of the truck.


NEXUS is built on the proven[AL4](https://www.worksport.com/products/al4) platform and adds **Active Lock Technology** , which holds the cover upright on its own instead of leaning it against the cab. The panels never touch your paint, so the back of the cab stays clean. Drop in a cooler, slide in lumber or load a deer cart without ever circling the bed.


- Single-sided auto flip up and close, no prop rods
- Full bed access, protects cab paint by staying off it
- Eight cable-operated Quick Latches
- Up to 400 lbs of evenly distributed load capacity
- Installs with no cutting, trimming or drilling, and no drainage tubes
- Made in the USA, with a 3 Year Limited Warranty and Lifetime Support


**[Shop NEXUS Now](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus)** | **[See NEXUS Fitment for Your Truck](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus)**


## Sealed against fall and winter weather


Gear in the bed should stay dry. NEXUS uses a **Dual-Lock Sealing System** : a full perimeter seal plus full-length rail seals down each side, blocking water before it gets in. There are no drainage tubes to route, clog with wet leaves or freeze in January.


No tonneau cover is waterproof, and any brand that tells you otherwise is setting you up for disappointment. A quality hard cover is weathertight, and that is what NEXUS is built to be.


## Built like a Worksport should be


NEXUS uses premium coated panels made with aluminum up to 3x thicker than the thin composite panels on many competitor covers, for real dent and scratch resistance with a low-profile look. Eight cable-operated latching points hold it down, and it supports up to 400 lbs of evenly distributed weight, which matters when the first heavy snow lands on it.

## Frequently asked questions


**What makes NEXUS different from other tonneau covers?** NEXUS is the first Worksport hard cover with an Auto Flip-Up design powered by Active Lock Technology. Flip it up from one side and it automatically locks upright. There are no prop rods, so you get full bed access from one side of the truck.


**Is a flip up tonneau cover better than a trifold?** It depends on how you load. A flip up cover like NEXUS opens the whole bed from one side, which is fastest for frequent loading. A trifold like[AL3](https://www.worksport.com/products/al3) or[HD3](https://www.worksport.com/products/hd3) folds back in sections, sits lower, and leaves part of the bed covered when folded.


**Will NEXUS fit my truck?** NEXUS fits most popular half-ton, heavy-duty and mid-size trucks, including the F-150, Silverado, Sierra, Ram 1500, Tacoma, Tundra, Gladiator, Ridgeline, Frontier and Maverick. Confirm your year, model and bed length on the[product page](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus) .


**Is NEXUS hard to install?** No. It installs without cutting, trimming or drilling, has no drainage tubes, and ships with all the hardware you need.


**Are tonneau covers waterproof?** No tonneau cover is waterproof. NEXUS is weathertight: a full perimeter seal plus rail seals actively block most rain, snow and dust without drainage tubes.


**How much weight can NEXUS hold?** Up to 400 lbs of evenly distributed weight. Clear heavy snow promptly rather than letting it build up, and never use the cover as a work surface.


**Does a tonneau cover keep my gear secure?** A cover secures cargo in the bed and keeps it out of sight. It is not a security device and does not prevent theft.


**Is NEXUS made in the USA?** Yes. NEXUS is made in the USA and backed by a 3 Year Limited Warranty and Lifetime Support.
